Blackstone Private Markets Fund (BXPM), the first from its Portfolio Solutions unit, offers non-U.S. investors PE, infrastructure, real estate and credit.

Blackstone launched a perpetual fund that, for the first time, gives eligible non-U.S. investors access to its private equity, infrastructure, real estate and credit businesses through one allocation. Blackstone Private Markets Fund (BXPM) is also the first product from Blackstone Portfolio Solutions, which the $1.3 trillion firm formed in March within its Private Wealth business. […]
